summary: XMR ~$630 (+9.2% 24h; headlines say +12% to ~$650 intraday), breaking a long-term range. Narrative is hack-driven demand (Railway breach drained ~$371k, LiteLLM supply-chain attack) rather than a protocol event. Buzz up ~1.5x after a 45% multi-month run, so overheat risk is high; kept near neutral despite the move.
catalyst_note: No XMR-specific dated catalyst; rally attributed to third-party hacks
